Spirit Burn rewards builds that can reach its spirit-damage trigger, adding an explosion, damage over time, and healing reduction. It combines damage scaling with anti-sustain pressure, but you must trigger the effect before the enemy's recovery decides the fight.

Spirit Power reduction is not a flat reduction to all incoming damage. It does not silence, disarm, cleanse an effect on you or apply anti-heal. Do not assume it changes damage already applied, damage stored by a previous cast or existing summons without verifying the interaction.
